aggressiveness.description: The user can select an aggressiveness level. Range 0-100. Refer to interface specification for details on how this value affects the Site Tuner parameters.

mobile.description: Setting this flag indicates the configuration is for a mobile device (mounted on a vehicle/vessel). Some commonly occurring threat types may be disabled, or have their detection settings adjusted. Clearing this indicate that the device is no longer mobile.

from.description: Analysis period start time in UTC ISO 8601 format

to.description: Analysis period end time in UTC ISO 8601 format

excludeTypeIds.description: List of detection type ids ( refer to threatType from ThreatTypeList) to exclude from suppression
